title: Cubic lanthanide sulfido clusters: Ln8S6(SPh)12(thf)8 (Ln = Pr, Nd, Gd)

material_class.structural_family: cubic Ln8S6 cluster with face-capping S2− and edge-bridging μ-SPh

synthesis.procedure: Under nitrogen, Gd metal (2.42 mmol), PhSSPh (0.791 g, 3.62 mmol), and Hg (0.06 g, 0.3 mmol) were combined in thf (35 ml) and stirred for 1 d to give Ln(SPh)3. Elemental sulfur (0.058 g, 1.8 mmol, 0.75 equiv. to Ln) was added; after 3 d the yellow-green solution was filtered to remove a trace of black solid and the filtrate was layered with hexane. Colorless crystals of Gd8S6(SPh)12(thf)8·2.9thf were collected. The crystals lose lattice thf and become amorphous within hours of isolation.
synthesis.time: 1 d for Ln(SPh)3 formation, then 3 d after sulfur addition
synthesis.vessel_or_method: nitrogen atmosphere; filtration then hexane layering crystallization
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered to remove a trace of black solid; filtrate layered with hexane to give colorless crystals
synthesis.yield: 0.44–0.57 g, 42–57% (range for the Pr/Nd/Gd series; longer saturation times give larger yields)
